result.description: Forensic FX audit engine: detects hidden bank spreads vs mid-market rates on currency transactions, via REST API and MCP server.
result.auth_detail: Static API key (prefix ipx_live_) generated in dashboard, sent as Authorization: Bearer header. No OAuth.
result.access_detail: Free tier gives only 3 audits (pricing page says lifetime; MCP tool text says per IP per month). Production API plans: Developer $99/mo sandbox, Starter $499/mo, up to $4,999/mo, Enterprise from $100K/yr; banks contact sales. No KYC/approval seen for key generation. Pricing pages inconsistent.
result.api_notes: 3 endpoints: POST /audit, GET /rates, POST /audit/document. Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 signed. Base URL is a Supabase functions URL; api.ipayx.ai custom domain 'coming soon'. Docs show two different base paths (fx-public-api-v1 vs fx-audit-engine).
result.blocker: Narrow API (3 endpoints); real use needs paid plan after 3 free audits; docs/pricing inconsistent; vendor claims unverified.

evidence.quote: Authenticate using a Bearer token from your backend.
Generate and manage your key in the Dashboard.
Detect hidden bank spreads vs mid-market benchmark on any currency transaction.
